SHOP-NS-001.summary: Connect your Shopify store, Melonn logistics operator, and NetSuite ERP in a seamless integration. Automate synchronization of customers, orders, invoices, payments, credit notes, and inventory. Ideal for omnichannel businesses (online and physical stores) that need a single place to consolidate commercial, financial, and logistics information. Fewer errors, more efficiency.
SHOP-NS-001.cardSummary: Automates customers, orders, payments and inventory between Shopify, Melonn and NetSuite. Ideal for real omnichannel.

Our system indexes your files using vector embeddings and allows any employee to ask questions in natural language. Get accurate answers with the original source cited. Your company's knowledge, available without tedious searching.
AI-KM-001.cardSummary: Ask in natural language. Get answers with sources. Ingests manuals, policies, and contracts. Accurate answers citing the original document.

DEV-INT-001.cardSummary: ERP with e‑commerce, CRM with marketing, legacy with cloud. Automated, clean, and reliable data flows.
